claims.text: A roadmap is a plan of the outcomes a team intends over the coming periods, firm for near ones and looser further out.
technical-strategy.md lists actions H1-H6 and leaves the order and timing of the actions to roadmap.md.

At stage-4, release 1 of the shop_id work is estimated (13 points, assumed) and forecast; release 3 (row-level security) is designed in multi-shop-data-rollout.md but not estimated, and sits in 'Sau đó' with no date.
claims.source_hint: docs/team/roadmap.md @ stage-4 lines 15, 20-21, 40; docs/design/multi-shop-data-rollout.md @ stage-4 lines 51-64

claims.text: roadmap.md (made in Sprint 23, assumed) uses three horizons now/next/later; each item is an outcome a shop or the team can see, not a feature with a fixed date, and names the technical-strategy.md action it serves; an item serving none is questioned before it is placed.
Only 'Bây giờ' items carry a forecast; 'Tiếp theo' has only order and 'Sau đó' has no date, because the further out, the less is known.

Items now: release 1 of multi-shop-data-rollout.md (H1, 2 to 3 sprints) and base backup and WAL in a second region, away from the machine running the database (H4, 3 to 4 sprints, inside the fixed share).

Forecast: 8-11 points from four full-staffed sprints; 4/5 (6.4-8.8) for roadmap items; 13/8.8→2, 13/6.4→3; backup 5 points (assumed) at 1.6-2.2 per sprint → 3 to 4 sprints, taking the whole fixed share while it runs, so register debts wait; recomputed each sprint planning.

claims.text: Each sprint keeps one fifth of its points for tech-debt-register.md items and platform work; debts are chosen by interest and repayment cost in the register, highest interest and cheapest first; fixed because, compared each time, the feature almost always wins.

Each time an item changes horizon the team logs the reason; the one row moves real email via Dịch vụ A (the outside email service chosen by ADR 0024) from now to next in Sprint 23: no production yet, and ADR 0024 changes no code at stage-4.
claims.source_hint: docs/team/roadmap.md @ stage-4 lines 52-59; docs/team/notification-requirements.md @ stage-4 line 18

claims.text: The one-fifth fixed share is the team's choice, not a rule; a platform item can sit in now and be paid from it. Review: each quarter with technical-strategy.md and whenever the strategy changes; forecasts of items now are recomputed at every sprint planning.
claims.source_hint: docs/team/roadmap.md @ stage-4 lines 16, 44-50, 61-64; docs/team/technical-strategy.md @ stage-4 lines 57-61

claims.text: Uncertainty grows with distance, so a roadmap should claim less the further out it looks; a far-off date reads like a promise.

Trade-offs: horizons fit long work with far items not yet estimated; a dated schedule fits short, estimated, stable work, and a missed date tends to read as a slip; an unordered list is raw input at most; next-sprint-only fits one small team without outside stakeholders.

Recommended choices not written in Đơn Hàng's files: answer a date request for a later item with its place after release 2 and that a forecast needs release 3 to be estimated; after an incident keep the fixed share and let forecasts of items now move.
claims.source_hint: outline items 2, 4; roadmap.md lines 8-9, 46-50; multi-shop-data-rollout.md lines 36-64

claims.text: A request serving no action is questioned first; if it answers a weak point of the diagnosis, the strategy changes first and the roadmap follows.
